$comment: The conformance corpus registry. One row per real-world platform whose data model FDS is tested against. This file is the single source of truth for what the corpus covers; check-conformance.mjs reads it and proves that what it declares is on disk, validates, and cites the RFCs honestly. Adding a platform is adding a row here and the files it names — see conformance/METHODOLOGY.md.

modes.transform: Real source records run through the built fds-transformer CLI; the output must validate against the published schema. Proves FDS can be produced from the platform's actual export shape. Used for flat, record-per-row entities (exercise libraries).
modes.fidelity: A real platform artifact modelled by hand as FDS and validated against the published schema, with a documented field-by-field mapping and gap list. Used for the deeply nested entities the transformer's dotted-path engine does not emit (workouts, programs).
